# LinkEDA releases

## macOS 0.0.119

LinkEDA 0.0.119 is the first downloadable native macOS installer build. It is
available for Apple Silicon Macs running macOS 14 or later.

### Highlights

- A standalone installer with a private R 4.6 runtime.
- A smaller installer that uses an existing Apple Silicon R 4.6 installation.
- A precompiled R package for users who prefer to start LinkEDA from R or
  RStudio.
- Both editions include the R packages used by the application, exact LinkEDA
  source archives and third-party notices.
- Native linked data sheets, plots, scopes, model windows, export and example
  data in a normal Applications-folder installation.

The application is ad-hoc signed for internal integrity. The packages are not
yet signed with an Apple Developer ID or notarised by Apple. The download page
explains the one-time approval through **System Settings > Privacy & Security**.

[Download the macOS installers](getting-started.qmd#download){.button .button-primary}

## Windows v0.0.113R

`v0.0.113R` identifies the first public Windows release. The R package and
application use the numeric functional version `0.0.113`; the final `R` is the
publication marker for the build made available to other users.

### Highlights

- Two double-click Windows installers: a complete edition with a private R
  runtime and a smaller edition for users who already have R.
- Native linked data sheets, plots, selections, explicit case exclusions and
  immutable analysis scopes.
- Linear, binary, count, positive-continuous, proportion, scale,
  dimensionality, missing-data and multiple-imputation workflows calculated in R.
- Shared R verification recipes and publication exports.

[Download the Windows installers](getting-started.qmd#windows){.button .button-primary}

## Licensing and verification

Binary installers are attached to GitHub Releases instead of being committed
to the source repository. Checksums are published on the download page. The
software is distributed under GPL version 3 or later; original published
documentation uses CC BY-NC-ND 4.0.
